_readme: The chapter vocabulary for SET 2026. APPROVED by Umar, 5 Aug 2026; all 1,000
questions are tagged against it in tags.json.
Bucket key is 'class|stream|section'. For XI/XII the section is the printed
subject; for IX/X, whose paper is one undivided 100 questions, it is the block
derived in extract.py (English, GK, History, Geography, Life Science, Physical
Science, Mathematics). Stream is part of the key because XI/XII Arts and
Commerce Economics are genuinely different papers.
Names follow the WB board syllabus chapter headings where the question content
maps cleanly onto them; where a paper ranges wider than one chapter (General
Knowledge especially), the grouping is thematic instead.
Editing this file alone will break the build: tag.py checks every name used in
tags.json exists here, and that every chapter here catches a question.
